finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb (center + 6 ring) with top covers on all cells and caps on all 18 open edge faces (12 perimeter edges with 3 caps per outer cell, 6 inner shared edges not capped as they are joined). Mesh clash clear; only warning is LOOSE_BODY suggesting joint bolts for structural locking but build is valid per checks.
